body.statement: For every observed law \(p=p(P_0)\) induced by some \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) and every fixed \(t\in\mathcal T\), the lower construction returns one law \(P_t^-(p)\in\mathcal F(p)\) satisfying \(Q_{1,P_t^-(p)}(t)-Q_{0,P_t^-(p)}(t)=\underline\Delta(t;p)\). Both marginal quantiles in this equality are generated by the same compatible law.
body.justification: Separate same-law attainment makes the lower coordinate endpoint genuinely sharp rather than a difference of independently optimized marginal bounds.
body.gap: The marginal trimming formulas do not by themselves establish attainment of their difference within one latent completion of the noncompliance-and-selection model.
body.consumer: Each lower-endpoint sign label in the Job Corps assertion list has an auditable compatible-law witness.
